title: CC Reminder signed helper manifest
description: Authoritative record of every packaged helper binary. The desktop app bundles this manifest from its resource directory and, at runtime, installer::helper::load_bundled_installer selects the entry whose target_triple matches the current compile target and verifies the staged helper bytes (SHA-256 + length) against it BEFORE the stable per-user copy is touched. A manifest path or checksum is NEVER accepted from runtime configuration (design 9.1). The placeholder entry below is the documented shape; release packaging (.github/workflows/release.yml) replaces the helpers array with one real entry per target triple compiled into this platform's bundle (signed cc-reminder-hook bytes, real length, real SHA-256; macOS universal builds carry one entry per slice triple). Development builds therefore fail selection with configuration.helper_unavailable — an honest typed error, never a fallback to placeholder bytes.
